description: This file defines the ScalesTableModel class, which extends DefaultTableModel to provide a data model for displaying scale information in a JTable component within the application's GUI. It manages a list of Scale objects and provides methods to retrieve column data, determine table size, and configure display properties.

classes.name: ScalesTableModel
classes.description: A table model that manages a list of Scale objects and provides data for a JTable to display scale properties such as name, expression, unit, format, and range values.

methods.name: getColumnCount
methods.description: Returns the number of columns in the table, corresponding to the number of scale property names.

methods.name: getColumnName
methods.description: Returns the name of the specified column.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the value for a specific cell in the table based on the current list of scales.

methods.name: getRowCount
methods.description: Returns the number of scales in the list, determining the number of rows.

methods.name: getColumnClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of data in a specified column, inferred from the first row.

methods.name: isCellEditable
methods.description: Indicates that all cells in the table are non-editable.

methods.name: setScalesList
methods.description: Sets or updates the internal list of Scale objects managed by the table model.
